verdict.wrong_value: NaN float16 values were not cast to NaT (NPY_DATETIME_NAT) when cast to datetime64/timedelta64; observed behaviour not recorded.
verdict.rationale: The PR fixes mishandling of the special value NaN when casting float16 arrays to datetime64/timedelta64. NaN should become NaT, but the conversion instead relies on undefined NaN-to-integer behaviour, losing the special-value invariant. This is a numerical special-value bug.
